items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: But my favorite drummer after I was big enough and got into the music game was Chick Webb.

ctx.x: Well, my favorite drummer was Chick Webb. Well, Chick Webb. That was my favorite drummer. You didn't hear him until late years. Until late years, but I mean, he was my favorite drummer of all time. He wasn't fancy or nothing like that.

He was just a good drummer and a good cymbal maker. Yeah, he was really good. Then I liked Peggy, something hard. He used to play with the Tennessee 10th. I never knew. No, he was a good drummer. But my favorite drummer after I was big enough and got into the music game was Chick Webb. That was my favorite drummer.

Did you hear him out here or was it in New York? No, I heard him in Chicago once. Well, he was in Chicago. Once, yeah. I think it was one of the show when I did. Yeah. I heard him at the Apollo Opera in the Harlem Opera House in 125th Street. Yeah, well, he was my favorite drummer. Savoy Ballroom. I didn't know he got out west anyway because he was crippled and didn't know how much. No, this was Chicago.
